CRUMBLE for Mac - how to install
================================

1. Double-click "Crumble-VST3-macOS.zip". You get "Crumble.vst3".

2. Close your DAW.

3. Open Terminal (Cmd+Space, type "Terminal", Enter) and paste these
   three lines one by one (Enter after each). It will ask for your Mac
   password - type it blind, letters don't show, that's normal:

   sudo rm -rf /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/Crumble.vst3
   sudo cp -R ~/Downloads/Crumble-macOS/Crumble.vst3 /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/
   sudo xattr -cr /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/Crumble.vst3

   (If you unpacked somewhere else than Downloads/Crumble-macOS, change
   the path in the second line - or type "sudo cp -R " and drag
   Crumble.vst3 from Finder into the Terminal window, then add
   " /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/" and press Enter.)

4. Open the DAW and rescan plugins.

The last line removes the macOS "downloaded from the internet" lock.
The plugin isn't notarized by Apple (that costs $99/year), so without
that line macOS refuses to load it.
